title: The mechanical connection point.
body_1: The reel seat is where rod, reel and angler become one load-bearing system. ASSAULT uses a heavy-duty Fuji DPS configuration selected for secure reel retention, offshore reliability and compatibility with large PE6-8 spinning reels.
body_2: Once installed, the reel foot occupies the seat opening and the principal Fuji branding is positioned on the underside.
